# Independent descriptor references

The `sdk06-native-*` files are raw Windows reference outputs and the exact PowerShell source used to produce each output. They use only local Advapi descriptor conversion/validation APIs. They do not access Active Directory and are not server-version or acceptance-test evidence. Each JSON file records the host build, toolchain, source SHA-256 and API scope.

* `reference-initial` uses security-information selector `0x0f`. Its text conversion filters some non-audit SACL classes. The original bytes and observations remain unchanged; use its binary values rather than its filtered text to test preservation of those classes.
* `reference-full` uses selector `0x1ff`, including resource attributes, mandatory labels, scoped policies and trust labels. It retains both accepted inputs and native rejections. The synthetic unknown ACE has native-valid binary but cannot be formatted as SDDL by Windows; binary preservation must not depend on SDDL representability.
* `binary-controls` derives labelled binary variants from `reference-full`'s change-password descriptor. Native validation accepts nonzero reserved ACL/header bytes, the resource-manager control byte, and unused ACL capacity. These bytes must survive an unchanged binary round trip even though SDDL cannot represent them.

The `.gitattributes` rule disables text conversion for these captures and source snapshots so recorded hashes identify committed bytes. These are independent expected values, not values generated by the implementation under test.
